title: Dynamic Network Analysis of Negative Emotions and DSM-5 Posttraumatic Stress Disorder Symptom Clusters During Conflict
limitations: - Limited sample size; - Focus on peritraumatic context only; - Linear models assumed stationarity; - No direct comparison with other symptom groupings; - 12-hr lag may not capture fleeting emotions; - No power calculation for sample size.
notes: The study used ESM data collected during a conflict period, which may limit generalizability. The authors did not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered, but the code was declared available. Data availability was not explicitly stated as available.
